prompt:
Summarize this support thread in exactly three bullet points for an account manager.

Customer (Mon): Our invoices for October show 40 seats but we only have 32 active users.
Agent (Mon): Thanks, I can see 8 users were deactivated on Oct 3. Billing should have prorated.
Customer (Wed): Still no correction. Our finance team needs this before month-end close.
Agent (Thu): Escalated to billing. A refund for 8 seats for October will be issued within 5 business days.
Our team shipped 9, 14, 11, and 14 features in the last four quarters. What was the total, and what was the mean per quarter? Answer in one sentence.

Extract a JSON object with keys "priority" (one of low, medium, high), "component", and "customer_impact" (one sentence) from this bug report. Return only the JSON.

Title: Checkout button unresponsive on Safari 18
Body: Since this morning's deploy, roughly 30% of Safari users cannot complete checkout. Revenue dashboard shows a dip. Chrome and Firefox unaffected.
Write a single SQL query (PostgreSQL) over a table orders(id, customer_id, created_at, total_usd) that returns each customer's total spend in 2026, highest first. Return only the SQL.
In under 80 words, explain to a non-technical executive what 'p95 latency of 2.4 seconds' means and why we track it instead of the average.

Rewrite this engineering note as a customer-facing release note of at most 40 words, no jargon: 'Fixed N+1 query in /orders endpoint; p95 dropped from 1.8s to 0.6s; also bumped pagination default to 50.'

Classify the sentiment of each review as positive, negative, or mixed. Answer as a numbered list with one word per line.
1. Setup took five minutes and support was great.
2. Love the reports, but the mobile app crashes daily.
3. Cancelled after the second outage this month.
A vendor offers a 30% discount if we sign a 3-year contract today, with no exit clause. List the two most important risks for a mid-size SaaS company, in two short sentences.
